summary: Fusion is a lightweight RSS aggregator and reader designed for collecting and viewing web feeds. It provides a centralised interface to track updates across multiple content sources. The application is distributed under the MIT licence and built using Go.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want a minimal, self-hosted feed reader deployed via Docker without heavy resource footprints.
watchOut: Given the modest repository metrics and maintenance score, you should expect slower community support and fewer feature updates compared to more established alternatives.
deployNotes: As a containerised Go application, it will typically require persistent storage volumes for your feed data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
